strings.name: Ho Kwon Ping
strings.summary: Ho was a journalist detained under Singapore’s Internal Security Act in 1977. He later entered the family business and developed Banyan hotels with his wife Claire Chiang and others. His hospitality work combines resorts, local culture and environmental concerns. He helped establish Singapore Management University and served as its founding chairman, stepping down in 2023 while continuing business and public debate.
